name: Commerce Customers Also Bought
description: Displays products that customers often buy together with the current product.
project_description:
The Commerce Customers Also Bought module will help you boost your sales. It displays products purchased by other customers who also bought the product the current customer is viewing.

 How to use it 

 After installing the module, go to the block layout at `/admin/structure/block` and place the "Commerce Customers Also Bought" block in any region you want. In the block settings, you can choose how many products to show to the customer and select the product view mode. If you place the block on a non-product page, products will be randomly chosen from all commerce orders.
